title: Lipschitz bound, in the field, for the pairing ∫_Ω Df(b) when f is C-Lipschitz on Ω
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, C ≥ 0, and let f : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C-Lipschitz on Ω. Let b, b' : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ be Lebesgue integrable on Ω. Then |∫_Ω Df(w)(b(w)) dw − ∫_Ω Df(w)(b'(w)) dw| ≤ C·∫_Ω |b(w) − b'(w)| dw. Here Df(w) = fderiv ℝ f w (the Fréchet derivative where it exists, 0 otherwise), and all integrals are Bochner integrals for Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ = Eucl n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (C : ℝ≥0) (f : Eucl n → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith C f Ω → ∀ b b' : Eucl n → Eucl n, IntegrableOn b Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → IntegrableOn b' Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → |(∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ f w (b w)) - ∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ f w (b' w)| ≤ C * ∫ w in Ω, ‖b w - b' w‖
